note: Both sets cover the same core facts from §7.2 and the filter paragraph, but Set B garbles several numeric values: it invents a 'rated generator torque 5.296E10 MW' claim with a fabricated quote, misreads 43,093.55 Nm as '43.093.55 Nm', and drops the exponent in the Region 2 constant (Nm/rpm instead of Nm/rpm²). Set A's only clear numeric error is the rated mechanical power (5.298610 MW instead of 5.296610 MW), and it also captures the rated mechanical power fact that Set B omits entirely. Both sets state the Region 2 torque law as merely 'proportional' to filtered generator speed, losing the square dependence.
remarks: Text layer and image agree; the page clearly reads 'rated mechanical power is 5.296610 MW' and '43,093.55 N•m', so Set B's 5.296E10 MW claim and its quote are fabricated rather than a text-layer artifact. Both sets bind the 6.9 rpm minimum rotor speed to a generator/controller entity rather than the rotor (Set A's binding is the looser of the two). Both sets also bind the 'up to fourth order' state-space statement to the Baseline Control-Measurement Filter, whereas the text attributes it to the alternative filter designs that were considered and rejected.
